title: SKU guardrails, quota limits, and sales amplification playbook for pricing change
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Coordinate the launch of the Q2 pricing and SKU changes with clear operational guardrails (quota limits, entitlements mapping), aligned release notes, and a targeted sales enablement program. Deliverables: SKU mapping table, entitlement enforcement plan, billing migration checklist, release notes draft, sales play deck, customer FAQ.
scope: Define final SKU definitions and canonical naming for API plans and console tiers
Agree quota and limit semantics (per-account, per-team, burst allowances) and enforcement windows
Coordinate billing-side mapping and migration scripts with finance and billing infra
Create release notes and in-product banners for affected customers
Field enablement: sales deck, objection handling, one-pagers, pricing calculator
out_of_scope: Changes to backend token metering implementation (engineering infra ticket will be separate)
New payment model negotiations for enterprise customers—handled by sales as exceptions
Legal contract language updates (legal will provide standard addendum if needed)
milestones: 2026-03-05: SKU naming freeze and canonical table published
2026-03-18: Quota enforcement policy doc reviewed by infra & security
2026-03-25: Billing mapping scripts ready in staging
2026-04-06: Release notes and customer comms finalized
2026-04-10: Launch (soft cutover with monitoring and rollback window)
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Nair (billing infra), Mateo Alvarez (runtime)
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): apply new SKU labels to 5% of self-serve signups and monitor token billing reconciliation for 72 hours
Phase 2 (Gradual): enforce new quota semantics for 20% of accounts with dedicated observations and telemetry
Phase 3 (Full): global enforcement with billing cutover and final announcement
Rollback criteria: billing delta > 5% for > 2 consecutive days for the canary cohort OR > 3% increase in failed requests due to limit enforcement
release_notes: Headline: Simplified SKUs and clearer quota limits for consistent billing and predictable performance
Detail: Consolidated developer-friendly SKUs, new burst windows, and per-account quotas to reduce noisy neighbor impact
Migration: Automatic entitlement mapping for existing customers; enterprise customers will be contacted for manual mapping if needed
Impact: Most customers will see no immediate change to experience; some customers might see adjusted limits (preview link to quota calculator)
Support: 24/7 triage channel and dedicated migration window for customers with usage > 1M tokens/week
sales_enablement_tasks: Draft field play deck with migration messaging and objection handling
Create pricing calculator spreadsheet and Chrome extension for quick quoting
Prepare outbound email templates for high-usage customers with recommended next steps
Host live Q&A and rehearsal with SEs on 2026-03-28
Compile a one-page decision tree for sales to identify customers requiring manual migration plans
engineering_tasks: Implement quota enforcement toggles behind feature flags
Add entitlement mapping script with dry-run and reconciler
Update billing export to include new SKU identifiers
Instrument telemetry to track per-customer billing deltas and limit hits
Create automated smoke tests for billing reconciliation during canary
design_tasks: Design console banners and migration notices
Update billing settings UI with new SKU labels and estimated monthly costs
Create in-product guided tour for account admins explaining new quotas
Design assets for sales one-pager and email templates
communication_channels: Customer comms: in-product banner, release notes, targeted email
Internal: #pricing-launch Slack channel, weekly GTM sync, launch war room
External: blog post and knowledge base article
Support: triage runbook and shared PagerDuty schedule for launch week
success_metrics: Average time to resolve quota-related support tickets < 4 hours for top 100 customers
<2% customers require manual entitlement remediation after automatic mapping
No more than 5% increase in support volume attributable to pricing change in first 14 days
Sales enablement: SEs report >= 85% confidence in messaging in post-training survey
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SKU table published and approved by finance
Billing mapping dry-run reconciles within 0.5% for canary cohort
Sales enablement materials published and field rehearsal completed
Release notes reviewed and published, with KB article live
Feature flags allow safe rollback and observability dashboards show required metrics
checklist: QA console UI and banners in staging
Publish release notes draft and legal sign-off
Run sales rehearsal and publish play deck
Open war room and monitoring before canary
risks: Billing reconciliation discrepancies leading to customer trust issues
Quota enforcement causing unexpected throttling for edge-case workloads
Miscommunication to customers causing churn or increased support load
Enterprise contracts that conflict with new SKU boundaries requiring manual negotiation
notes: Prefer automatic mapping for self-serve customers; flag enterprise customers for manual outreach
Prepare a short FAQ targeted at developer concerns (tokens vs requests, burst windows)
Coordinate with marketplace partners to ensure SKU IDs are synced before full cutover
